job: Drafting a criteria-based frontier-model recall mechanism that defines the triggering capability threshold and foreign-national access rule replacing ad-hoc orders.
outcome: A published rule, interim final rule, or formal framework specifying ex-ante criteria for suspending access to a deployed frontier model.
motivation: The Fable 5 / Mythos 5 shutdown on undisclosed verbal evidence is legally fragile and an unstable, contestable governance posture.

task.who: agency policy and regulatory drafting staff
task.what: draft ex-ante recall criteria and capability threshold
task.why: replace contestable ad-hoc shutdowns with stable criteria
task.how: interim final rule or formal framework document

job: Building the due-process and evidence standard that lets a capability-based suspension survive legal challenge after the evidence-undisclosed Fable 5 precedent.
outcome: A codified evidence and due-process standard inside the published recall rule governing how and when a frontier model is suspended.
motivation: An evidence-undisclosed shutdown invites litigation and industry pushback; a written standard defends future suspensions and deters challenges.

task.what: codify evidence and due-process suspension standard
task.where: the recall rule's legal-authority and procedure sections
task.when: during the June 2026 to Q2 2027 drafting runway
task.why: make capability-based suspensions defensible against legal challenge
